items.evidence: Baseline with stated protocol (128x128, warmup 5, runs 15, 3 reps), per-stage medians, variance policy (median robust, differences meaningful only outside min-max spread).
Transform identified as hotspot (~97% via measured medians) with ~4x-per-doubling scaling; encode measured (~1ms) not assumed.
Encode proposal evaluated with alternating in-process probes (65.04 vs 65.82 ms at 1024x1024) — indistinguishable, rejected with evidence; fix targets transform.
Byte-identity via sha256 before/after at 128/256/512/1024 all identical, plus cmp and unchanged bench bytes field.
Minimal fix confined to transform.js (compute average once, O(in+out)), no caching or stage-shifting.
Same protocol/input/reps after fix with per-stage before/after medians and min/max (transform 25.9→0.086ms).
Distinguishes looks-slow from is-slow — append vs join probed indistinguishable; superlinear trend shared by both attributed to serialization/GC.
Environment caveats reported (no CI, single machine, uncontrolled load, JIT warmup) with validity argument; overlapping encode measurements treated as inconclusive.
